manual: Rust via rustup (install.sh installs it). Do not use Debian apt rustc/cargo — gtk4-rs needs rustc ≥ 1.92.
First transcription downloads the whisper model (~1.6 GB) to ~/.local/share/omarchy-meeting-recorder/models/.
Optional chapters need a default agent (omarchy-default-agent / Menu → Setup → Default Agent).
Optional bar waveform: accept the first-run offer, or symlink plugin/ into ~/.config/omarchy/plugins/jankeesvw.meeting-recorder and omarchy-plugin-enable jankeesvw.meeting-recorder --section right.
